theater: 塔巴斯科南岸托爾圖格羅

battle.name: 第四次「星際大戰」
battle.theater: 塔巴斯科南岸托爾圖格羅
battle.brief: 公元644年，墨西哥灣最南端的托爾圖格羅王巴赫拉姆·阿豪在一次星際大戰中擊敗未具名的政權，碑文記下「血聚成池、骨堆成山」；五年後他再取科馬爾卡爾科。卡面的亞述長矛屬西亞鐵兵器，從未進入中美洲；位置上相應的，是托爾圖格羅軍中用燧石矛頭的長矛與投矛器。

kit.name: 亞述長矛
kit.history: 短柄、長刃，配著鐵鏃。亞述人把它和弓、鐵器綁在一起，兩河流域的城一個接一個陷落。

countries: 第四次「星際大戰」是城邦對城邦的戰爭，交戰一方是塔巴斯科南端的托爾圖格羅，另一方是一個連名字都沒有留下的政權。中文版《戰爭列表（公元1000年以前）》的表格在公元644年一欄只寫下「托爾圖格羅」，參戰方一欄標為「不明」，這就是這場戰爭史料的真實狀態：它由托爾圖格羅王室的石碑記下，記的是得勝的一方，敗方王名、人數、路程都無從查證。托爾圖格羅位於墨西哥灣岸最南端的塔巴斯科，聖佩德羅河入海口一帶，約北緯17度41分、西經92度34分，是瑪雅世界西緣的海港城邦。它的統治者沿用與恰帕斯州帕倫克相同的「巴阿卡爾」王號徽記，說明它在儀式與正統上自視為帕倫克王統的一支。托爾圖格羅並不孤立：往東是佩滕盆地的蒂卡爾與卡拉克穆爾，往北是馬雅低地的科馬爾卡爾科，另有西面的卡爾薩諾與薩卡瓦。當時瑪雅世界沒有國家，只有一個個自治城邦，每座城邦的指揮系統由城邦王、祭司集團與貴族世系三層構成：祭司用金星曆與260日曆圈定出征日，國王下達星戰令，各世系按名冊出丁，由族長帶隊。沒有常備軍，沒有職級化的將官，統兵者就是王與他最信任的貴族；同樣沒有中央政府可以命令別的城邦出兵，聯盟要靠血緣、婚約與共同的敵人臨時拼湊。因此這場星戰在編制上是一支以世系精銳為骨幹、附帶農民與隨從的城邦遠征軍，而不是國家與國家之間的會戰。
countriesEn: The Fourth 'Star War' was a clash between two city-states. One was Tortuguero, on the southern edge of Tabasco; the other was a polity whose name was never written down. The Chinese-language list of wars before the year 1000 gives only the site, Tortuguero, for the year 644, and marks the belligerents as 'unknown', and that is the honest state of the evidence. The war survives because a carved stone in the royal precinct of Tortuguero recorded the side that won; the losing ruler's name, the numbers involved and the route taken are all lost. Tortuguero lay in southernmost Tabasco in Mexico, at the mouth of the San Pedro River where it meets the Gulf of Mexico, at roughly 17 degrees 41 minutes north, 92 degrees 34 minutes west, and it was a harbour city on the western rim of the Maya world. Its rulers used the same B'aakal emblem glyph that served as the primary title at Palenque in Chiapas, which shows that in ritual and in legitimacy Tortuguero counted itself as a branch of the Palenque royal line. Tortuguero was not isolated: to the east lay Tikal and Calakmul in the Peten basin, to the north the lowland city of Comalcalco, and to the west the Chontal towns of Calais and Saka. In 644 the Maya world had no states, only a patchwork of autonomous city-states, and each one's command structure had three layers: the city lord, the priestly group and the noble lineages. Priests fixed the day of departure from the Venus cycle and the 260-day count, the ruler issued the call for the star war, and each lineage supplied the men it owed, led by its own head. There was no standing army, no ranked officers and no general: the army was the king and the noblemen he trusted. No central government could order another city to march, so coalitions had to be improvised out of kinship, marriage and a common enemy. The Fourth 'Star War' was therefore, in order of battle, a city-state expedition built on a core of lineage elites with farmers and retainers attached, and not a set-piece battle between nations.
people: 留下第四次星際大戰記錄的人是托爾圖格羅的國王巴赫拉姆·阿豪，「巴赫拉姆」在瑪雅語裡是「老虎」，「阿豪」是「君王」之號。學界依《瑪雅諸王編年》把他的統治期記為約公元644年至679年，也就是說，644年那場星戰很可能就是他即位前後的立國之戰。他使用的「巴阿卡爾」王號徽記與帕倫克君主一系相同；644年時帕倫克的統治者是金納布·帕卡爾（在位603至683年），這位帕倫克王以精通曆算與石刻著稱。戰役的另一半決定權在祭司手裡：星戰不是隨時可打的仗，出征日要由祭司依金星曆與260日曆的週期圈定，選定之後才由國王向各世系發出星戰令。真正下場的是貴族領兵人與各城的戰士；被俘的敵方君主按慣例被帶回城邦，接受以灑血、散心臟為名的儀式，這是瑪雅城邦對付敵國君主的標準做法。碑文的抄寫與刻石由王室祭司團隊完成，同一批人也在托爾圖格羅留下別的碑刻，包括記著13巴克通紀元終點的那一件。十九、二十世紀的盜掘者把托爾圖格羅的石碑一批批運走，碑面被砸毀、遺址被挖空；一九六〇年代一座水泥廠直接建在遺址核心區上，直到今日托爾圖格羅在考古學上只剩殘片可拼。現代學者靠比對流散各國館藏的碑面，才把巴赫拉姆的統治期、649年攻下科馬爾卡爾科、以及644年那句「血聚成池、骨堆成山」還原出來。
peopleEn: The name that survives with this battle is that of the king of Tortuguero, Bahlam Ajaw: 'Bahlam' is the Maya word for jaguar, and 'Ajaw' is the title for a lord. Following the Chronicle of the Maya Kings and Queens, his reign is placed at roughly 644 to 679 CE, which means the star war of 644 was very probably the war that established a new ruler. He bore the B'aakal emblem glyph, the same title used by the Palenque dynasty, and the Palenque king in 644 was K'inich Janaab' Pakal, who reigned from 603 to 683 and was celebrated for his mastery of calendrics and stone carving. The other half of the decision lay with the priests. A star war was not a thing that could be fought at will: the day of departure was fixed by the ritual specialists through the Venus cycle and the 260-day count, and only then did the ruler send out the call for the war. Those who actually fought were the noble commanders and the warriors of each town, and the captured enemy ruler was customarily taken back to the victorious city and put through the rite of scattering the blood and scattering the hearts, the standard treatment of an enemy monarch in Maya city-states. The copying and the carving of the inscription were the work of the court's priestly specialists, the same hands that left Tortuguero's other monuments, including the one that records the end of the 13th baktun. In the nineteenth and twentieth centuries looters carried off Tortuguero's stelae batch by batch, smashing the carved faces and hollowing out the site; in the 1960s a cement factory was built directly over the core of the ruins, and what remains of Tortuguero archaeologically is fragmentary. Modern scholars have reassembled the text from pieces held in collections around the world, and out of them have recovered Bahlam's reign, his conquest of Comalcalco in 649, and the line 'the blood was pooled, the skulls were piled' that stands for the war of 644.
kits: 卡面上的亞述長矛屬於另一個世界：短柄、長刃、配鐵鏃，是約公元前九百年新亞述帝國的步兵兵器，亞述人把它和弓、鐵斧、鐵鎚綁在一起，兩河流域的城一個接一個陷落。這種兵器從未出現在中美洲，理由很直接——瑪雅世界沒有鐵，沒有冶鐵的爐與錘，鏃、刃、斧一律用燧石、黑曜石與玉髓製作；卡面兵器所代表的，在托爾圖格羅的庫存裡是「矛」這個類別：木杆前端安一枚葉狀或三角狀的燧石矛頭，兼作近身突刺與投擲，規格從一人高到接近兩人高不等。真正決定射程的是投矛器，用短木柄配皮帶與石墜做成，槍桿尾端有杯形凹口，靠甩臂的爆發力把標槍送出去，可及百步上下，速度與精度都在弓之上。弓仍在用，但箭少，箭鏃小，多是骨或石；黑曜石刃的棍劍則是砍殺與破甲的主力，一柄十餘公斤；盾是木框蒙棉布、可捲曲的長方盾，貴族另有棉甲與木盔，充其量擋得住標槍與石彈，擋不住集中的矛雨。攻城方面，瑪雅人沒有投石車，也沒有成熟的攻城塔，靠的是梯、木架與火：燒屋、砍柱、拆碑。托爾圖格羅臨海，運糧與運兵多靠人背、人抬，小舟只沿岸線走，沒有車、沒有馬、沒有任何馱獸。卡面那件亞述長矛在此只作對照：它標示的正是列陣、突刺、破城這一段在托爾圖格羅軍中的位置。
kitsEn: The Assyrian spear on the card belongs to a different world altogether: a short haft, a long blade and an iron point, the infantry weapon of the Neo-Assyrian Empire around 900 BCE, which the Assyrians used together with the bow, the iron axe and the iron pick as city after city in Mesopotamia fell. It never reached Mesoamerica, and the reason is plain: the Maya world had no iron, no furnaces or hammers for smelting it, and points, blades and axes were worked in chert, obsidian and jade. What the card weapon represents in the stores of Tortuguero is the class 'spear' itself, a leaf-shaped or triangular chert point set at the front of a wooden shaft, used both to thrust at close quarters and to be thrown, ranging from about one man's height to nearly two. Range, however, was the business of the atlatl, made of a short wooden handle with a cord and a weight, its shaft ending in a cup-shaped socket, whose sudden swing of the arm drove the dart out for a hundred paces or more with more speed and accuracy than any bow. Bows were still used, but sparingly, with small bone or stone points, while the heavy club-sword with inset obsidian blades, a weapon of some ten kilograms, was the tool for killing and for breaking armour. The shield was a wooden frame covered with cotton cloth, rectangular and flexible enough to be rolled up, and nobles also had padded cotton armour and wooden helmets, good enough to stop a dart or a stone missile but useless against a concentrated volley of spears. Maya besiegers had no stone-throwers and no developed siege towers; they used ladders, wooden frames and fire, burning roofs, cutting columns and breaking stelae. Tortuguero sat on the coast, so grain and men moved on human backs and in small canoes along the shore; there were no wagons, no horses and no draught animals of any kind. The Assyrian spear on the card serves here only as a comparison, marking exactly the place of the line, the thrust and the breach in Tortuguero's army.
tactics: 瑪雅城邦的星戰是一場有固定程序的儀式性戰爭，程序本身就是戰術。祭司先圈定出征日，國王在城門前主持儀式，祭司以玉米粉灑地、以香火淨化道路，軍隊在鼓與號角聲中出城；美加斯加瑪雅抄本與龐貝克壁畫留下過最完整的星戰圖像：戰士列成密集的縱隊，前排持投矛器，後排拋射標槍，敵我接近後以長矛突刺、棍劍劈砍，最後由精銳突入對方陣中活捉國王。托爾圖格羅的戰役大概沿用同一套邏輯：出兵的時節在旱季，五月到十月的雨季道路泥濘、溪流暴漲，不利遠征，而此時玉米已入倉，糧食好帶，沿河谷與海路行軍不必就地徵發，所以西緣城邦的遠征多集中在十一月至翌年三月之間，644年那一仗的月份落在這段窗口內，碑文本身並未留下月日。對手是誰，碑文也沒有留下；能確定的是，攻城方不僅要打下城牆，還要摧毀對方的權威象徵——碑刻、廟宇、王室器物都要拆毀或遷走，俘獲的君主則被帶回本城，作為這場戰爭合法性的證物。托爾圖格羅四面臨海、內陸河道縱橫，遠征可以走海路，也可沿聖佩德羅河與內陸水系轉運，因此它的兵縱隊不需很長，但每次出動都必須帶足十日份的玉米餅與鹽，以及修築野營所需的柴薪。
tacticsEn: A Maya star war was a ritualised war with a fixed sequence, and the sequence was itself the tactic. Priests fixed the day first; the ruler performed the rite at the city gate, priests scattering maize meal on the ground and purifying the road with incense, and the column marched out to drum and trumpet. The Mesoamerican codices and the Bonampak murals preserve the fullest images of a star war: the warriors stood in dense columns, front rank with atlatls, rear ranks hurling darts, closing to spear thrusts and club blows, and finally an elite broke into the enemy line to seize the king alive. The campaign of Tortuguero presumably followed the same logic. The season was the dry one: from May to October the rains turned the roads to mud and swelled the streams, making distant campaigning impossible, whereas in the dry season maize was already in store, food was easy to carry, and movement along the river valleys and the coast did not have to be paid for by requisitioning on the spot, so the campaigns of the western cities cluster between November and the following March; the month of the war of 644 falls inside that window, the inscription itself having kept no day. The opponent is not named in the text either. What is certain is that the besiegers did not stop at the walls. They also destroyed the symbols of authority: stelae, temples and regalia were broken up or carried off, and the captive ruler was brought back to the besieger's own city as the proof of the war's legitimacy. Tortuguero faced the sea on several sides and was crossed by inland waterways, so a column could travel by sea or be shifted along the San Pedro River and the interior network of channels; its armies did not need to be long, but every column had to carry enough maize cakes and salt for about ten days, together with the firewood needed to build the camp.
data: 關於第四次星際大戰，能寫下的數字很少，而且每一個都另有出處。年份是公元644年，戰場是托爾圖格羅，位置在今墨西哥塔巴斯科州最南端，約北緯17度41分、西經92度34分，位於聖佩德羅河與墨西哥灣交會的潟湖地帶。統治者巴赫拉姆·阿豪的統治期被記為約644年至679年。649年，也就是星戰後第五年，他攻下科馬爾卡爾科——瑪雅世界最西端的城址之一，也是托爾圖格羅在墨西哥灣沿岸擴張的關鍵一環。戰役本身的規模沒有留下數字：碑文只記勝負、記君主被擒，不記兵員，因此兵員、陣亡、被俘人數都只能說「無記載」，不可推算。第七世紀屬晚期古典期，佩滕盆地與烏蘇馬辛塔河谷的城邦在此時連年開戰，657年多斯皮拉斯襲擊蒂卡爾、662年占領蒂卡爾、678年蒂卡爾反攻摧毀卡拉克穆爾，都是這段記錄可對照的座標。托爾圖格羅出土的另一塊碑——記著13巴克通紀元終點、亦即2012年那一段預言的碑——現藏紐約大都會博物館與塔巴斯科比亞霍馬的卡洛斯·佩利塞爾博物館，說明這座城址的碑石幾乎全部流失到館藏與私人手中；一九六〇年代的水泥廠則抹掉了遺址的另一半。
dataEn: Few numbers survive for the Fourth 'Star War', and each of them has its own source. The year is 644; the place is Tortuguero, at the southern tip of the Mexican state of Tabasco, at about 17 degrees 41 minutes north and 92 degrees 34 minutes west, in the lagoon country where the San Pedro River meets the Gulf of Mexico. The reign of Bahlam Ajaw is recorded as roughly 644 to 679 CE. In 649, five years after the star war, he took Comalcalco, one of the westernmost sites of the Maya world and the hinge of Tortuguero's expansion along the Gulf coast. The scale of the fighting itself left no figure: the inscription records the result and the capture of the ruler, not the numbers, so the numbers of men, of the fallen and of the prisoners can only be given as 'not recorded' and must not be computed. The seventh century belongs to the late Classic period, when the cities of the Peten basin and the Usumacinta valley were at war almost year by year: the attack of Dos Pilas on Tikal in 657, the capture of Tikal in 662 and the destruction of Calakmul by Tikal's counter-stroke in 678 are the fixed points against which 644 can be read. Another monument from Tortuguero, the one recording the end of the 13th baktun, that is, the year 2012, is now in the Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York and in the Carlos Pellicer Museum at Villahermosa in Tabasco, which shows how thoroughly the stelae of this site scattered into museum collections and private hands; the cement factory of the 1960s removed the other half.
cause: 要理解第四次星際大戰為何會打起來，得先看清644年的瑪雅西部：卡拉克穆爾在佩滕盆地一家獨大，多斯皮拉斯在其西側崛起，蒂卡爾被壓得抬不起頭，所有城邦都在尋找新的靠山，而位於墨西哥灣岸、握有海鹽、漁獲、貝類、染料與可可貿易的托爾圖格羅，恰好是佩滕諸城的商品流向海灣的門戶。城邦之間的衝突從來不是單純的軍事角力：土地、鹽田、可耕地與水權要靠碑上的授田記錄確認，貿易的轉折點要靠碑銘記載，每次星戰都被寫成一次儀式性的正義行動，勝方用俘獲的君主當作合法性憑證，敗方則被記為該受懲罰的一方。巴赫拉姆·阿豪在644年前後即位，並且立刻打贏一場對外星戰，很可能正是新王立威的做法：對外證明自己配得上巴阿卡爾這個名號，把西緣的商路與附庸城邑收到帳內。敵方是誰，史料沒有留下名字；可以確定的是，它被當成一場星戰的對象，也就是說，它在托爾圖格羅的儀式語言裡被視為有資格被擒獲的敵國君主，而不是一支可以忽略的盜匪。649年他再取科馬爾卡爾科，說明644年那一役並非孤例，而是同一個擴張方向上的第一步。
causeEn: To see why the Fourth 'Star War' was fought, one must look at the western Maya in 644. Calakmul dominated the Peten basin, Dos Pilas was rising on its western flank, Tikal was pinned down, and every city was looking for a new patron, while Tortuguero, sitting on the Gulf coast with the salt, the fish, the shell, the dye and the cacao trade in its hands, was precisely the gateway through which the goods of the Peten cities reached the sea. Conflict between Maya city-states was never a simple military contest. Land, salt pans, tillage and water rights had to be confirmed in the carved records of land grants, the turning points of trade were written into the monuments, and every star war was presented as a ritual act of justice: the victor held the captive ruler as his warrant of legitimacy, while the defeated were written down as those who deserved it. Bahlam Ajaw's accession around 644, followed at once by a victorious star war abroad, fits the classic behaviour of a new king, proving outward that he was worthy of the name B'aakal and drawing the western trade route and its subordinate towns into his account. The enemy is not named in the record. What can be said is that it was treated as the object of a star war, that is, in Tortuguero's ritual language its ruler was thought worthy of being taken alive, and it was not a band of raiders to be ignored. That Bahlam took Comalcalco in 649 shows the war of 644 was not an isolated affair but the first step along a single direction of expansion.
impact: 這場戰爭的直接後果，是托爾圖格羅從一個西緣的中型城邦，變成墨西哥灣岸足以號令周邊的強權：星戰得勝與五年後攻下科馬爾卡爾科，構成同一條擴張線的兩端，而托爾圖格羅與帕倫克共用巴阿卡爾王號徽記，則說明它在正統上把自己接到了西邊最古老的一支王統上，這在晚期瑪雅世界是極重的政治資本。更遠一層，644年之後的佩滕並沒有因此安寧：多斯皮拉斯與卡拉克穆爾在東邊爭奪蒂卡爾，678年蒂卡爾反攻摧毀卡拉克穆爾，705年多斯皮拉斯反過來摧毀蒂卡爾，半個世紀裡西緣的強權與佩滕的強權反覆易手，晚期古典期的所謂崩潰其實是一連串權力轉移的結果，而不是一次性的崩壞。對後世考古學而言，644年這條記錄更重要：托爾圖格羅是晚期古典期瑪雅西部最完整的王表之一，巴赫拉姆的碑文讓學者第一次能把西緣城邦的戰爭放回佩滕的座標裡，修正了把西部視為邊陲的舊說。遺憾的是這份記錄的載體極脆：碑面被盜掘者砸毀，遺址在一九六〇年代被水泥廠壓住，銘文靠散落各國館藏的殘片拼回，每一次的釋讀都意味著把碎片再多對幾次。
impactEn: The immediate consequence of the war was that Tortuguero, a middling city on the western edge, became a power able to speak for the Gulf coast: the victory in the star war and the taking of Comalcalco five years later are the two ends of a single line of expansion, while the B'aakal emblem glyph shared with Palenque placed Tortuguero, in terms of legitimacy, in line with the oldest surviving royal line of the west, which was a very heavy political asset in the late Maya world. Further afield, the Peten did not grow quiet because of 644. Dos Pilas and Calakmul fought over Tikal in the east, Tikal's counter-stroke destroyed Calakmul in 678, and Dos Pilas in turn destroyed Tikal in 705; across half a century the strong powers of the west and of the Peten changed hands again and again, and the so-called collapse of the Terminal Classic was in truth a sequence of transfers of power rather than a single break. For later archaeology the record of 644 matters even more. Tortuguero preserves one of the most complete royal sequences of the late Classic western Maya, and Bahlam's inscriptions allowed scholars for the first time to place the wars of the western cities back inside the geography of the Peten, correcting the old view of the west as a mere periphery. Regrettably, the vehicle of that record is extremely fragile: the carved faces were smashed by looters, the site was capped by a cement factory in the 1960s, and the text had to be recovered by matching fragments held in collections abroad, so that every new reading of it means fitting a few more pieces together.
result: 第四次「星際大戰」以托爾圖格羅的完勝告終：巴赫拉姆·阿豪率軍在644年攻破一個未具名的政權，擒獲其君主，碑文以「血聚成池、骨堆成山」這句話記下結果——這是瑪雅碑銘常見的修辭，把勝負寫成祭祀的收成，勝方的榮耀與敗方的毀滅被綁在同一個畫面裡。敵方是誰、被打的是哪一座城，碑上沒有留下名字，這場戰爭因此在後世的史表裡只以一場星戰的名義存在。對托爾圖格羅自己，結果是實實在在的：國王的權威在即位之初就得到確認，隨後五年裡他把勢力伸到瑪雅世界最西端的科馬爾卡爾科，控制海路與鹽、貝、可可的交換節點，舊都的城邦在隨後兩三代裡持續承認這份宗主地位。結果的另一面是代價與後續的消耗：托爾圖格羅的鼎盛不長，晚期古典末期的戰亂與環境壓力讓西緣城邦逐一退場，遺址最終被放棄，沼澤與林地覆蓋了廟基；二十世紀的盜掘與水泥廠，更讓這次星戰只餘一句碑文。今日我們知道644年有過這樣一場戰爭，靠的是殘存的石刻與散佚的館藏，而不是任何一部完整的戰史。
resultEn: The Fourth 'Star War' ended in an outright victory for Tortuguero. Bahlam Ajaw's army broke an unnamed polity in 644 and took its ruler captive, and the inscription records the outcome in the phrase 'the blood was pooled, the skulls were piled', a common Maya rhetorical turn that writes the result as the harvest of a sacrifice and binds the victor's glory and the defeated's destruction into a single image. The enemy is not named, no city is given, and the war therefore survives in later lists only under the name of a star war. For Tortuguero itself the result was solid: the king's authority was confirmed at the very beginning of his reign, and over the following five years he extended his reach to Comalcalco, the westernmost city of the Maya world, taking control of the nodes where sea salt, shell and cacao changed hands, and the old capital went on acknowledging that overlordship for two or three more generations. The other face of the result was the cost and what followed. Tortuguero's ascendancy was short: the wars and the environmental pressures of the Terminal Classic closed down the western cities one by one, the site was eventually abandoned, and marsh and forest covered the temple platforms; and in the twentieth century looting and the cement factory left this star war with a single carved sentence. Everything we know today about a war of 644 comes from the surviving stone and from scattered collections, not from any continuous chronicle of it.
